story_position: Chapter 3 — Beat 14 — Rest in Caelora / Morning Departure
scene_purpose: Let Mirena stop the party from immediately pushing onward to Cresthaven, give the new four-person permanent party a genuine low-pressure evening in Caelora, then open a short next-morning preparation window and let the player choose when to leave for Cresthaven. The evening exists primarily so the four can be people together after the Old City sequence, not to advance another mystery.

sections: Beat 14 — Rest in Caelora / Morning Departure

scene_context_seed.location_name: Caelora — private palace room, then Crown guest quarters / common room, then morning city preparation window
scene_context_seed.runtime_note: Begin immediately after Mirena identifies Cresthaven in Beat 13. Mirena should make the practical decision that the party rests tonight and leaves tomorrow. The evening scene should not be assigned a topic, joke, emotional lesson, or bonding milestone. Give the four food, fatigue, cleanup, ordinary objects, and enough room for their brains to discover what they actually do together. Torren is already socially comfortable with Cyanis and Ilyra and may be terse or expansive according to the moment; do not preserve terseness as a target. Nimera is still new to Torren in Chapter 3, so practical friction or early chemistry must not become paternal/father-daughter shorthand yet.

hard_outcomes: After Cresthaven is identified, Mirena tells Cyanis, Ilyra, Torren, and Nimera to stop for the night rather than leave immediately.
Mirena tells them to head for Cresthaven the next morning when they are ready.
Mirena states that she will come to / meet them at Cresthaven later the next day with Maevra and an organized Crown support / work group.
The permanent four receive a real low-pressure decompression scene in Caelora involving ordinary needs such as food, washing up, equipment cleanup, fatigue, sitting, or similarly mundane behavior.
The evening does not introduce a new investigation answer, attack, dream, Card event, magical escalation, recruitment milestone, or required emotional confession.
Torren's short or long turns are chosen by current mood, comic timing and interest rather than a permanent terse-character rule.
Torren and Nimera remain new acquaintances; the scene may deepen early social chemistry but does not perform later paternal/familial care.
Nimera's profanity remains a normal high-frequency feature of her adult speech rather than a one-off joke or a required quota.
The next morning opens a short player-controlled preparation window in Caelora.
The player chooses when to select Leave for Cresthaven.
The road journey is skipped rather than played as a dungeon or encounter route.
Selecting departure ends Beat 14 and hands directly into Beat 15 at Cresthaven.
production_cost_ceiling: short Mirena handoff + one compact four-person evening scene + next-morning player preparation window and departure selection
